expectations.text: Advises starting coarser / not pre-splitting the three phases into many files up front
expectations.evidence: "resist the old reflex of carving everything into tiny files"; "Don't pre-split the job module into start-job.ts / poll-job.ts / complete-job.ts."

expectations.text: Co-locates tightly coupled job lifecycle / polling
expectations.evidence: "Job orchestration → keep it together (export-job.ts)... co-locate the job lifecycle in one file." Polling kept in one useExportPoller hook.

expectations.text: Recommends an abstraction (function/module) over bare file splits
expectations.evidence: "For the React side, reach for an abstraction rather than file structure. A useExportPoller(jobId) hook... has a real interface that hides its implementation."

expectations.text: Mentions a ~300-line threshold (or 'a few hundred lines') as the split trigger
expectations.evidence: "Only split when it crosses ~300 lines or starts covering genuinely separate concerns."
